capabilities: Write flashcards in anki fenced blocks inside any note
Push cards to an Anki deck via the sync command
Pull edits made in Anki back into the original note
Preserve stable card IDs so review history survives resyncs
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installed as a beta plugin via BRAT; requires Obsidian desktop since AnkiConnect is desktop-only.
motivation: The author states the note-taking stack is broken because notes and spaced repetition never talk to each other, and the plugin closes that loop.
problem: Notes live in Obsidian and spaced repetition lives in Anki, so users must copy-paste cards between the two apps and keep them consistent by hand.

relations.evidence: Two-way sync between your Obsidian markdown vault and Anki via AnkiConnect.

summary: Two-way sync of flashcards between Obsidian notes and Anki: write anki fenced blocks, push to Anki via AnkiConnect, and pull edits back.
